title: MetaMask Partners Ondo Finance to Integrate Tokenized US Stocks, ETFs, Commodities
text: MetaMask and Ondo Finance have announced an integration bringing tokenized US stocks, ETFs, and commodities directly into MetaMask wallet via Ondo Global Markets. The integration gives non-US MetaMask Wallet app users access to more than 200 tokenized US securities on the Ethereum mainnet including US stocks such as Apple, Amazon, ...
